name: biv_isovolumic_caps_C
title: BiV isovolumic contraction, caps + zero-slack chordae (C)
description: As A (Posterior caps), plus 97 OCS12 chords with their own Ogden law and no slack, from the annulus cap to the PM tips on the moving wall. Fill to 4 mmHg, then 4 to 40 mmHg with the T0 that holds the RV + trunk volume.

name: biv_isovolumic_caps_B
title: BiV isovolumic contraction, caps x10 (B)
description: Fill to 4 mmHg on RV + trunk + caps, then pressure 4 to 40 mmHg with the active stress T0 that holds the RV + trunk volume (found by iteration). Valve replaced by flat shell caps, card x10. T0 in RV free wall + septum only.

name: biv_isovolumic_caps_C2f
title: BiV isovolumic contraction, chordae spread over the cap (C2f)
description: Posterior caps plus 97 zero-slack OCS12 chords from the PM tips to points spread over the tricuspid cap (closed-valve mapping; each chord shared over neighbouring cap nodes, 681 rods). Outflow wall passive. Fill to 4 mmHg, then FEBio's volume constraint holds the RV + outflow volume while the active stress T0 ramps until the cavity reaches 40 mmHg (frame 25 onward). T0 195 kPa at 40 mmHg.

name: biv_isovolumic_caps_A
title: BiV isovolumic contraction, Posterior caps (A)
description: Fill to 4 mmHg on RV + trunk + caps, then pressure 4 to 40 mmHg with the active stress T0 that holds the RV + trunk volume (found by iteration). Valve replaced by flat shell caps, default Posterior Lee-Sacks card. T0 in RV free wall + septum only.
